purpose: OpenAI/Broadcom Jalapeño inference accelerator watch record.

hardware.architecture_note: Blank-slate accelerator designed specifically for modern LLM inference; OpenAI says the design reduces data movement and balances compute, memory and networking resources for higher realized utilization.
hardware.availability_note: Engineering samples are running ML workloads at production target frequency and power. OpenAI and Broadcom say initial deployment is planned by the end of 2026, with gigawatt-scale datacenter deployment over multiple generations.

performance_evidence.claim: performance per watt substantially better than current state-of-the-art

research_notes: Do not infer TOPS/FLOPS, memory capacity, memory bandwidth, process node, board power or price; none were published in the captured primary sources.
OpenAI says a detailed technical performance report will be presented in the coming months; that report is the primary promotion trigger.

This is a datacenter infrastructure platform rather than an expected retail/local inference accelerator, but it is directly relevant to LLM-specific ASIC architecture and performance-per-watt research.
